name: Orvieto
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Orvieto today is mostly a dry white, with small amounts of off-dry (abboccato) and sweet (dolce) wine.

blurb.text: A wine region in Umbria and Lazio around the town of Orvieto, known for white wine from mostly Grechetto and Trebbiano. Today's Orvieto is dry, with a semi-sweet Abboccato and a sweet style in small amounts.
